notes.title: New patch released
notes.content:
Okay, time for another update! This time I've gone through a fair bit of feedback people have sent me in various ways and fixed a large variety of issues. There's still a few things I would like to be able to change in the near future, but for now, I hope the new updates make the game a bit better!

Tweaks:
-Last boss of episode 2 made easier by making a few hitboxes smaller and [spoiler]making homing attacks track the player slightly less quickly[/spoiler]
-Nerfed damage output of Scorchsear and Security Overdrive
-Option to select non-HD cutscenes. (Useful if the HD cutscene engine doesn't work properly on your computer... some day I may implement a more proper fix for that, but in the mean time this will do)
-Dialed back one attack of the last boss of episode 3
-Moved a few enemies near the end of Scorchsear's stage to a different part of the stage to prevent them from immediately attacking you upon respawning at the checkpoint
-[spoiler]Xenotank[/spoiler] in Episode 3 now has a bit less health
-First boss of episode 3 had one attack tweaked a bit
-(Episode 2 spoilers) [spoiler]slowed down text during the quiz show as Zeta[/spoiler]

Bug-fixes:
-Fixed a bug where the password screen song would keep playing if the password entered led to [spoiler]the stage select segment in episode 2[/spoiler]
-Fixed (episode 3 spoilers) [spoiler]"choose path!" showing up before the final boss despite there only being one path[/spoiler]


Well, that's all for now I think! Hopefully I'll see you again in the future to fix a few more problems I know the game has that could use some work... they're gonna require a few major code changes though, so I wanted to get these ones out of the way first.

notes.title: Small bugfix patch released
notes.content:
Hi, lead dev and programmer of Xenogunner here. We just released a small bugfix patch. It only fixes one bug for now, the one that I felt most important to fix out of the ones people have reported so far. I plan to work on a larger patch in the coming days based on any issues that people find, but for now, this should fix an important one at least.

PATCH NOTES:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where two songs would play at once during the the last boss of episode 1 in Delta's story. (...this is what I get for forgetting to playtest both stories after making a last-second change in which songs play where...)
[/list]

I hope you all are enjoying the game so far!

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where two songs would play at once during the the last boss of episode 1 in Delta's story.
